dedupe_keys.name: data center migration planning document and telemetry bundle

description: This public repository packages a multi-facility data-center migration planning example. Its README lists server and storage inventories, workload requirements, vendor comparisons, a capacity-planning model, network architecture, bandwidth logs, environmental sensor tables, rack mapping and financial scenarios. The tree confirms spreadsheet, CSV, PDF and DOCX files with those names. The author declares CC0 1.0 and no access charge. The documentation does not name the facilities, project sponsor, measurement dates, collection method or a synthetic-data generator; vendor labels appear illustrative, but this review cannot establish whether any values came from operating sites. Coverage should therefore be treated as a scenario bundle of unknown operational authenticity, not a verified census of data-center capacity. Simulation use includes testing migration dependencies, rack-power constraints and workload reallocation workflows after inspecting the files. It complements data-google-cluster-workload-traces, which documents observed compute-cell workload traces, while this bundle covers planning artefacts. No spreadsheet, document, telemetry row or financial model was opened or run.
name: Data center migration planning document and telemetry bundle
notes: G8; G8-0665. Metadata and documentation checked. Data payloads and software execution were not tested. Simulation uses are curator interpretations.  Cited as: Data Center Migration Planning Dataset repository documentation. No independent study or facility provenance identified..
